h1: The 6 Best Portable Dishwashers Under $1000 of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: six portable dishwashers under $1000, from a rolling 18 inch unit to no-hookup countertop models for apartments and dorms.
summary: The SD-9263SSC is the best overall: an 18 inch rolling unit with Energy Star certification that connects to your faucet. The AIRMSEN is the countertop pick with the biggest interior for its footprint. The COMFEE' 6 place model offers eight programs, and its tank mini needs no hookup. NOVETE suits parents with a Baby Care cycle, and EUHOMY lists 40 dB.
intro: Plenty of products sold as portable dishwashers are really countertop boxes with a water tank, and the gap between the two types decides how many plates you can wash and how much fuss every cycle takes. A rolling 18 inch unit hooks to your faucet and fills itself. A tank model needs you to pour water in by hand, then empty it afterwards. For a renter with no plumbing access, the tank is the whole point. For a family, the rolling unit is the only format that scales.

We reviewed eight listings and kept six, all under the thousand dollar ceiling. Ranking on the Primea framework weighs unit type, hookup method, capacity, wash programs and listed noise, using spec sheets and listing details only. Capacity numbers are quoted as listed, not measured.

products.name: SD-9263SSC: 18″ Portable Dishwasher with ENERGY STAR, Stainless Steel
products.verdict: The genuine rolling dishwasher, not a countertop compromise.
products.description:
The SD-9263SSC is the only true portable dishwasher in the group. It is an 18 inch freestanding body on locking casters, with a stainless steel build and Energy Star certification, and it connects to a kitchen faucet through an included hose kit. It is not a fill-the-tank mini, so there is no pouring and no refilling mid-load.

It ranks first because it is a full-size appliance on wheels, while the others are countertop boxes. The AIRMSEN has a larger interior for a countertop model, and the COMFEE' units are cheaper, but none matches a rolling 18 inch unit. It sits in the $500 plus bucket, the highest here.

Buy it for a family kitchen with a faucet and no built-in dishwasher. The caveat is thread type: the faucet must accept the adapter, so check before you order, and give it floor space.
products.idealFor: Renters wanting a real, rolling dishwasher.
products.skipIf: Your faucet cannot take a hose adapter.

products.name: AIRMSEN Large Slim Countertop Dishwasher | Built-in Water Tank
products.verdict: More interior room in a narrower countertop body.
products.description:
The AIRMSEN is the countertop unit with the most space. It has a built-in water tank and a large slim body that fits a bigger interior into a narrower footprint. It sits in the $200 to $500 bucket, the same as the other tank models.

It ranks second because capacity is the thing that frustrates countertop owners most, and this design addresses it. Against the COMFEE' 6 place settings, the AIRMSEN offers more room in a similar footprint, though the listing gives no program count. Against the SD-9263SSC, it sits two buckets lower and needs no faucet connection.

Choose it for a small kitchen where you want more capacity without plumbing. The caveat is the refilling routine: a tank means pouring water in each cycle, and the listing does not name a gallon figure.

products.name: COMFEE' Countertop Dishwasher, Energy Star Portable Dishwasher, 6 Place Settings & 8 Washing Programs, Speed, Baby-Care, ECO & Glass, Dish Washer for Dorm, RV & Apartment, Black
products.verdict: Eight programs and Energy Star in a countertop box.
products.description:
The COMFEE' 6 place model is the most flexible countertop unit. It carries Energy Star certification, holds 6 place settings and offers 8 programs, including Speed, Baby-Care, ECO and Glass. Having a Glass cycle matters if you wash delicate stemware, because a shorter, gentler program protects it.

It ranks third because the AIRMSEN holds more in a similar footprint, but this one gives you more control. The tank mini from the same brand has fewer programs, and the NOVETE has five. It costs $200 to $500.

Choose it for a dorm, RV or apartment with one or two users. The caveat is capacity: six place settings suits one or two people, not a family.
products.idealFor: Dorms and RVs with varied loads.
products.skipIf: You cook for a large household.

products.name: COMFEE' Portable Mini Dishwasher Countertop with 1.32Gal Built-in Water Tank for Apartments & RVs, No Hookup Needed, 6 Programs, 360° Dual Spray, 162℉ High-Temp & Air-Dry Function
products.verdict: A tank-fed mini with a 162 degree wash and air dry.
products.description:
The COMFEE' tank mini is the answer when plumbing is impossible. It has a 1.32 gallon built-in tank, needs no hookup and offers 6 programs with 360 degree dual spray arms. It heats the wash to 162 degrees F and finishes with air drying. High temperature helps with grease and sanitising.

It ranks fourth because the tank is small. At 1.32 gallons, it is a smaller machine than the 6 place COMFEE', with fewer programs than it. The NOVETE has a 5 litre tank and an optional inlet hose, which gives it more flexibility. It sits in the $200 to $500 bucket.

Buy it for an apartment or RV where you cannot connect to a faucet. The caveat is refilling: every cycle starts with pouring in water, and the capacity limits how much you can wash at once.

products.name: NOVETE Portable Countertop Dishwashers, Compact Dishwashers with 5L Built-in Water Tank & Inlet Hose, 5 Washing Programs, Baby Care, Air-Dry Function and LED Light for Small Apartments
products.verdict: Flexible tank or hose filling with a dedicated baby cycle.
products.description:
The NOVETE has a 5 litre built-in tank plus an optional inlet hose, which means it can run either way. It offers 5 programs, including a dedicated Baby Care cycle, an air-dry function and an LED indicator light. It costs $200 to $500.

It ranks fifth because five programs are fewer than the COMFEE' units, and the listing gives no place setting count. What lifts it for parents is the Baby Care cycle, which suits bottles and pacifiers. The optional inlet hose is its edge over the COMFEE' tank mini, since you can plumb it if a faucet is nearby.

Buy it for a family with an infant and a small kitchen. The caveat is the missing capacity figure, so check how many bottles and plates the interior holds.
products.idealFor: Parents washing bottles and small items.
products.skipIf: You want the widest program choice.

products.name: EUHOMY Countertop Dishwasher Portable, 6 Programs with 40 dB, No Hookup
products.verdict: A no-hookup countertop unit that lists a 40 dB noise level.
products.description:
The EUHOMY is the quiet one. It lists 40 dB, six programs and no hookup, in the $200 to $500 bucket. A stated decibel figure is valuable in a studio, where the machine runs a few feet from where you sleep.

It ranks last because the listing gives no capacity, tank size or feature list beyond programs. The quiet claim is also a manufacturer figure, not an independent measurement. The COMFEE' and NOVETE units list more features, and the AIRMSEN holds more.

Buy it for a studio or an open plan flat where noise matters. The caveat is that missing data. Confirm the capacity before you rely on it, and treat 40 dB as a claim until owners confirm it.

whatMatters.detail: A tank model needs you to pour in water, while a faucet-connected unit draws water automatically. Tanks suit renters with no plumbing access, but refilling adds a step to each cycle. Check whether the listing says no hookup or mentions an inlet hose. That one line saves a return. The NOVETE lists both a tank and an inlet hose, which gives it flexibility.

This number counts how many full place settings fit. Six, as on the COMFEE', is fine for one or two people but too little for a family. Read the capacity line and compare it with how many plates and bowls you use per day. The AIRMSEN and the SD-9263SSC do not state a place count, so check the dimensions.

Energy Star indicates better efficiency standards, which lowers running costs. The SD-9263SSC and the COMFEE' 6 place model carry it. Look for the term in the title rather than assuming, because many countertop units skip it. If you wash daily, an efficient unit pays back over time.

Extra cycles such as Glass, Baby Care and ECO let you match the wash to the load. They matter if you wash delicate items or baby gear. The COMFEE' lists 8 programs and the NOVETE 5. Count the named programs in the listing, and check that the one you want, such as Baby Care, is on the panel.

Measured in decibels, noise tells you how loud a cycle will be. Lower numbers suit studios and open plan rooms. The EUHOMY lists 40 dB. Look for a stated dB figure and treat it as a manufacturer claim, because the other listings give none and real noise depends on the room.

cards.label: Countertop tank

howToChoose.note: Most buyers with a standard faucet should default to the rolling unit; renters without one should pick a tank model.

cards.text: No-hookup design, a compact footprint and an air-dry function that saves towel work.

faq.a: Tank models do not. You fill them with water by hand, while the SD-9263SSC rolling unit connects to a faucet. Check which type the listing describes, and decide whether you can live with refilling a tank before every cycle.

faq.q: Will the rolling unit fit any faucet?
faq.a: Not always. The faucet needs to accept the included adapter on the SD-9263SSC, so check the thread type. A tank unit like the AIRMSEN avoids the problem entirely, though it adds a refill step each time.

faq.q: Is a portable dishwasher worth it over hand washing?
faq.a: It saves time and water for regular loads. For one or two dishes a day, it may not, and a COMFEE' tank mini would waste more effort than it saves, since filling and emptying the tank takes longer than rinsing a plate.

faq.q: How do I clean a countertop dishwasher?
faq.a: Wipe the seal, rinse the filter and run a hot cycle occasionally. Empty the tank after use to prevent odors, especially on the NOVETE and EUHOMY, where standing water in a closed tank turns musty quickly.

faq.q: Can I wash pots and pans?
faq.a: Small units fit limited cookware. Large pans may need hand washing, while the SD-9263SSC has the room for bigger loads than any countertop box, so batch pots and pans there.

faq.q: Where should I place the unit?
faq.a: Use a stable counter near a sink or outlet, and leave space for the door and hose. The SD-9263SSC needs floor space beside a faucet, and a tank model only needs the counter and a way to drain.

finalTake: Buy the SD-9263SSC if you have a faucet and want a real dishwasher on wheels. Take the AIRMSEN for the largest countertop interior. Pick the COMFEE' 8-program model for variety, or its tank mini when no plumbing is possible. Choose NOVETE for a Baby Care cycle and EUHOMY for a quiet studio. Decide on hookup first, then capacity.
